dev.query: is this deployed contract safe to interact with or does it hide exploitable flaws
dev.note: Sibling discrimination on Chainlens: contract_audit, not token_holders/wallet_pnl. 'contract' also appears near token/wallet tools, so the security intent must carry the ranking.

dev.query: how fast does my call lose value each day as expiry nears if the stock barely moves
dev.note: Describes theta/time-decay without naming any greek. Must beat the three other QuantDesk tools on the same endpoint (rebalance, earnings, dividends).

dev.query: give me an expression that matches any valid phone number inside a block of text
dev.note: DevForge sibling pick: regex_build over code_review and dependency_audit, which share no vocabulary with a pattern-matching request.

dev.query: my photo looks grainy and small, make it sharp and much bigger
dev.note: PixelForge sibling pick: image_upscale, not video_caption or voice_clone. Query uses 'grainy/small/sharp/bigger' where the tool says 'resolution/detail/artifacts'.

dev.query: which newer studies have built on this particular paper
dev.note: Between-sibling grading on Scholarly: forward citations are citation_graph (grade 3); paper_search is a decent alternative that could surface citing work by topic (grade 2).

dev.query: surface prior scientific literature relevant to a hypothesis I am exploring
dev.note: Reverse of the previous judgment on the same endpoint: an open literature search is paper_search (3); citation_graph only helps once you already hold a seed paper (partial, 1).

dev.query: cheapest way to trade one crypto asset for a different one right now
dev.note: TradePipe sibling pick: dex_quote ('swap/route/best price'), not gas_estimate. Query says 'trade/crypto asset', the tool says 'swap/token/exchanges'.

dev.query: collect every product row from an online shop page as clean structured data
dev.note: Harvestly sibling pick: web_scrape for a web page, not pdf_extract or invoice_parse which read documents/invoices.

locked.query: did this address end up in the green after all its token swaps
locked.note: Chainlens has four tools on one URL; only wallet_pnl answers 'made or lost money'. Must beat token_holders, contract_audit and nft_floor_price, none of which the query shares words with.

locked.query: when do the shares I hold next pay me cash and how much per share
locked.note: Sibling discrimination on QuantDesk: 'pay me cash for holding shares' is dividends, not earnings_estimate or rebalance. The word 'dividend' never appears in the query.

locked.query: pull the tables out of a long scanned report so I can work with the numbers
locked.note: Between-sibling grading on Harvestly: pdf_extract is the answer for a scanned document with tables; invoice_parse is only partially relevant (it OCRs documents too, but is narrow to invoices). web_scrape is off-topic.

locked.query: predict what the network will charge me to push a transaction through soon
locked.note: TradePipe sibling pick: gas_estimate, not dex_quote. Both mention chains and transactions, so fee-prediction intent must decide it.
